There seems to be an error in the map on WH p. 430. On WH p. 433, the statue of Savion Amhara is described as aiming "a warning marble finger toward the Tear Gate, some three- quarters of a mile away." The only non-absurd reading of the text is that the map has switched the Amhara and Nethvin Markets.
